visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man holds a camera in a selfie position, his mouth moving as he talks directly to the viewer. Behind him, a woman smiles broadly and a teenage boy examines two yellow-and-red rectangular Kodak disposable camera boxes. They stand on a wooden deck in front of a modern building with a 'Blue Seal' ice cream sign featuring large decorative ice cream cones and 'OKINAWA' branding. (2) Close-up on the woman's face; she has long brown hair and wears a white top with a beige cardigan. She holds one of the yellow cameras, gesturing with it while laughing. The background shows a white building wall with informative posters behind glass. (3) The teenage boy in a white t-shirt is seen through a medium shot, holding the camera to his eye and pressing the shutter button. The scene transitions to the trio walking along a paved path under bright sunlight, surrounded by lush green tropical trees and a blue sky. (4) A rapid sequence of photos and short clips displays various locations: a beach with clear blue water and bright orange umbrellas, plates of hot ramen with steam, a box of French fries, the boy wearing a bucket hat, and the group laughing at a dinner table. Text overlays in Chinese appear intermittently at the bottom center of the frame.
